title: APEX Model Catalog
description: Shape of .github/model-catalog.json. The hand-maintained `models` block preserves descriptive metadata for known labels. The generated `assignments` block lists only definitions that explicitly carry a legacy model pin; active production agents use operator-selected runtime routing and normally leave both generated maps empty.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of last catalog update.

models.description: Hand-maintained descriptive metadata keyed by model display name. It does not assign models to active production agents.

runtime_id.description: Descriptive SDK model identifier for diagnostics and legacy metadata. Worker readiness does not compare or require model identifiers.

tier.description: Capability descriptor, or null when unverified. Not a runtime cost tier.

released.description: Release date (YYYY-MM format), or null when unverified.

provenance.description: Explicit provenance for an authorized label with unknown public metadata.

deprecated.description: Whether the model is deprecated. Deprecated entries may remain for audit history but must not appear in active assignments.

use_for.description: Recommended use cases for this model.

governance.description: Documents the canonical source-of-truth chain and the catalog's role within it.

source_of_truth.description: Plain-language statement of which file is canonical (agent frontmatter).

rules.description: Invariants enforced by the catalog validator.

assignments.description: Auto-generated inventory of explicit legacy agent → model pins. Active production assignments are intentionally omitted. Do not edit by hand; regenerate via `node tools/scripts/generate-model-catalog.mjs`.

generated.description: Always true; marks the block as generator-owned.

generated_by.description: Path to the generator script that produced this block.

agents.description: Map of explicitly pinned agent file basenames to legacy frontmatter labels; empty for unpinned agents.

subagents.description: Map of explicitly pinned subagent file basenames to legacy frontmatter labels; empty for unpinned workers.
